newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts certain REITS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney starts certain REITS.

text.p: -- Smith Barney initiated coverage of Beacon Properties Corp and Bedford Property Investors Inc as outperform, a Smith Barney source said.
-- Smith Barney started Koger Equity Inc as neutral, a source said.
-- Additional details were not immediately available.
-- Smith Barney later said it set a $39 a share price target for Beacon Properties. A time frame was not immediately available.
-- said Beacon is seasoned organization. Firm has "excellent grasp of and access to capital markets."
-- said Beacon has a strong management team, which takes a long-term view on assets and markets.
-- On Bedford Property, Smith Barney said it set a $19.50 a share target price.
-- said Bedford fits the profile of small capitalization, small base and strong growth REIT.
-- said Bedford has "solid but skinny manangement team" with strong local market knowledge.
